preview.text: Bhutan won the toss and chose to bat first against Mongolia in the T20 match at the YSD-UKM Cricket Oval. The usual first-innings score in the 10 recorded T20 matches at this venue is 125. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 100 per cent chance of rain and about 30 degrees.

summary.text: Bhutan won by 136 runs. BTN made 203-5, Tenjin Rabgey top-scoring with 108 off 58 balls; Sodbileg Gantulga took 2 for 21. MGL made 64-6, Sodbileg Gantulga top-scoring with 23 off 19 balls; Sonam Yeshey took 2 for 7. Sides batting first at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval usually make about 125.
